entries.346d6b34acd4ed91: This business provides engineering plastics, general-purpose plastics, packaging materials and other products to industries such as plastic compounds, masterbatches, resin raw materials and molded resin products, home appliances and OA equipment, electronics, packaging materials, daily necessities, household goods, and civil engineering and construction materials. In the value chain, it is positioned at the stage after upstream "Functional Materials." Sales to external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥206,690 million (down 1.9% from the previous year). By region based on location, Greater China was ¥92,719 million, Asean was ¥67,740 million and Japan was ¥37,173 million. Sales of resins for the electrical and electronics industry, including OA equipment, decreased, but at Nagase Rutakku, sales of industrial hoses and civil engineering pipes increased. Under the new medium-term management plan "Walk the Talk 2028," it is planned to be integrated into the "Materials" segment together with Functional Materials and Mobility.
entries.39987041bacb8c7c: This business supplies resin raw materials, solvents, pigments, dyes, various additives, high-purity chemicals, enzymes and other products to industries including paints and inks, pigments and additives, resins, urethane foam, surfactants, electronics chemicals, water treatment, functional films and sheets, and hygiene materials. It is positioned at the most upstream point of the value chain. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥153,642 million (down 0.1% year on year). By region based on location, Japan is the largest at ¥72,214 million, followed by ASEAN at ¥33,547 million and Greater China at ¥22,031 million. Sales of paint raw materials declined as demand for automotive and construction use fell, while sales of raw materials for semiconductor materials increased. Under the new medium-term management plan "Walk the Talk 2028", the company plans to integrate this business into the "Materials" segment together with functional materials and processed materials.

entries.9226169800de6740: This business provides modified epoxy resins, precision polishing materials, optical materials for displays, adhesive and sealing materials, and equipment related to semiconductors and electronic devices to industries such as semiconductors, electronic components, AR/VR, displays, touch panels, automotive and aircraft-related, storage batteries and renewable energy. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥172,891 million (up 7.2% year on year). By region based on location, Greater China was ¥76,709 million and Japan was ¥61,042 million. Sales of semiconductor materials increased; at Nagase ChemteX, modified epoxy resins were weak for mobile devices but firm for AI semiconductors. The Pac Tech group saw strong sales of wafer bumping equipment and contract bumping services. Under the new medium-term management plan 'Walk the Talk 2028', this segment is planned to be renamed 'Electronics'.

entries.96ed934f9e9401d0: This business provides pharmaceutical drug substances and intermediates, in vitro diagnostics, cosmetic raw materials, food ingredients and others to industries such as pharmaceuticals, food and beverages, cosmetics, agriculture, toiletries and healthcare; it is the segment with the largest revenue from external customers among the five reportable segments. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥309,207 million (up 7.7% year on year). By region based on location, the Americas was the largest at ¥137,508 million, followed by Europe at ¥81,138 million and Japan at ¥77,376 million. The U.S.-based Prinova group expanded market share in food ingredient sales and increased volumes. Sales of cosmetic materials at Nagase Viita were flat. In July 2025, Nagase Diagnostics Co., Ltd., whose predecessor was the diagnostics business division of Asahi Kasei Pharma, began operations and became a consolidated subsidiary. Under the new medium-term management plan 'Walk the Talk 2028', this segment is planned to be renamed 'Life Science'.

entries.fb7c17f50214076b: This business supplies various resins, functional paints, adhesives, lightweight components, decorative parts, HMI components, and CASE-related products (xEV-related components, thermal management components, battery materials, various sensors, LiDAR-related components, and autonomous driving technologies) to the mobility sector and related industries. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥130,256 million (down 1.4% year on year). By region based on location, Japan (¥41,538 million) and ASEAN (¥40,586 million) are the top two regions. Sales of resins were flat, while sales of functional materials and functional components for interior and exterior and electrification applications declined. Under the new medium-term management plan "Walk the Talk 2028", the company plans to integrate this business into the "Materials" segment together with functional materials and processed materials.
